before: House companion framework to SF657 program overhaul, including data center exclusion language.
after: Introduced HF1054 proposed a business incentives for growth program excluding data center businesses from eligibility, alongside broader tax incentive changes; SF657 was substituted.

before: Died in House Commerce Committee (no action after introduction 2026-01-13); 2026 Sine Die 2026-05-03
after: Introduced and referred to House Commerce on 2026-01-13; no later journal action appears in the history captured 2026-11-05. Historical lead: died in committee after the 2026 regular-session adjournment; final disposition unverified.

before: Would require water-efficient cooling technology for new data centers, encourage nonpotable and recycled water, require reporting, and authorize penalties.
after: Proposed water-efficient cooling standards for new and certain expanded or renovated data centers, cooling plans and annual compliance reporting, nonpotable water encouragement, and civil enforcement.

before: Died in House Ways and Means Committee (no action after introduction 2026-01-29); 2026 Sine Die 2026-05-03
after: Introduced and referred to House Ways and Means on 2026-01-29; no later journal action appears in the history captured 2026-11-05. Historical lead: died in committee after the 2026 regular-session adjournment; final disposition unverified.

before: Died in House Commerce Committee after amendments filed 2026-03-12 as HF2690; no floor vote before 2026 Sine Die 2026-05-03
after: HF2447 was renumbered HF2690 on 2026-02-23; HF2690 was placed on the House calendar that day, with amendments filed 2026-03-12. The 2026 regular session adjourned 2026-05-03; the retained bill history records no later action as of 2026-11-05.

before: Would require quarterly water and energy reports, DNR and Iowa Utilities Commission publication, and a separate electric service classification and tariff for data centers to reduce cost shifting.
after: Both introduced versions proposed quarterly water and energy reports and separate data-center electric tariffs. HF2447 also proposed a construction or expansion hold until the serving utility filed the tariff; that hold was omitted from introduced HF2690.
Signed by Governor 2025-06-06, Acts Chapter 148; the data-center Division XII took effect on enactment 2025-06-06; this date is not asserted for every omnibus division.

before: Died in House Ways and Means Committee after renumbering as HF2688 on 2026-02-23; no further action before 2026 Sine Die 2026-05-03
after: Renumbered HF2688 and referred to House Ways and Means 2026-02-23; history observed 2026-11-05 lists no later action. Prior lead: died at 2026-05-03 sine die; not independently verified.

before: Died in Senate Ways and Means Committee after renumbering as SF2373 (subcommittee assigned 2026-02-24); no further action before 2026 Sine Die 2026-05-03
after: Renumbered SF2373 2026-02-18; referred to Senate Ways and Means and subcommittee assigned 2026-02-24; history observed 2026-11-05 lists no later action. Prior lead: died at 2026-05-03 sine die; not independently verified.

before: Modifies MEGA program (Major Economic Growth Attraction) to incentivize a professional NFL stadium; the data-center exclusion language is in the MEGA program statutory framework that the bill amends.
after: Introduced SF2252 proposed expanding MEGA eligibility to a professional NFL stadium; the data-center exclusion was existing text, and the proposal did not add a data-center benefit.

before: Senate predecessor to HF976 omnibus tax revisions, including data center incentive provisions.
after: Senate companion to HF976 proposing omnibus tax revisions, including data center incentive provisions; HF976 was substituted for SF614.

before: Includes division affecting tax increment treatment of school foundation tax on qualified data center property.
after: SSB3001 proposed excluding school foundation taxes on qualified data-center property from tax-increment division of revenue, with site-preparation and proposed applicability conditions. Enacted SF2472, Acts chapter 1115, instead establishes broader school-foundation tax treatment in division XIII; that enacted text does not specifically identify data centers.
Senate Commerce Committee; Economic Development Authority origin unverified

after: Renumbered SF2301 then SF2506; SF2506 withdrawn 2026-05-03 after HF2799 substitution. Separate HF2799 signed 2026-06-02, Acts Chapter 1199.
